key_insight: The paper shows that joint logical measurements in quantum LDPC codes can be made much faster using only cat states plus a scheduler code to decode multiple commuting operators at once.
engineering_relevance: This reduces logical-operation latency in fault-tolerant quantum computing with LDPC codes, improving throughput for Clifford and non-Clifford circuits without requiring complex resource states.
method: Use cat states as the only ancillary resource for logical measurements.
